title: account-health-card template variables
description: Values for templates/account-health-card.md.j2 and templates/account-health-card.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from account-health-card.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

action_this_week.title: Action this week
action_this_week.description: What is the single action for this account this week? One action somebody will actually take - a list of five is a list of none.

client_name.description: Which account is this card for - the client name as it appears on the contract? One card per account per week; a card covering two accounts averages a red into a green.

health_score.title: Health score
health_score.description: What is the total score across the six signals, out of 12? Each signal scores 0, 1 or 2, so a score with no six rows behind it is a guess wearing a number.

health_tier.title: Health tier
health_tier.description: What tier does the total score put this account in? Read it off the score band rather than off your impression of the relationship.

notes.description: Anything a reader needs that the six signals do not carry - a sponsor change, a contract event, a conversation that has not shown up in the numbers yet?

period_label.description: Which week does this card cover, as YYYY-Www? The week the signals were measured in, not the week you wrote the card up.

trend.title: Trend
trend.description: Which way has the score moved since last week? A green account trending down is the one worth a conversation; a red one trending up usually is not.
